# Gate4B manufacturer references

Manufacturer documents are reference-only and remain unmodified. `SOURCES.json` records URLs, retrieval status and hashes. Manufacturers retain copyright; no open redistribution license is assumed. Downloaded PDFs are local review inputs and excluded from Git. No manufacturer PCB/CAD is copied. Project footprints are independently authored from package drawings; installed KiCad footprint provenance is recorded by the capture review.
